integrity: Self-contained proof with supplementary finite checker. No independent validation or audit.
scientific_limitations: The sufficient threshold m>=3N is not sharp; 2N<=m<3N is not classified. Fixed dimensions, iid continuous uniform nodes, consecutive frequencies only. Full Bass–Gröchenig 2004/05 text was inaccessible, so earlier equivalent results cannot be ruled out.
title: A finite-mean-risk regime for independently sampled Fourier frames
